title: Tahoe theme
description: MacTahoe GTK and shell theme in your variant's color, MacTahoe icons and cursors.
off_note: GNOME goes back to Yaru, Ubuntu's own theme. The light/dark switch is turned off too.

title: Wallpapers
description: Your light and dark wallpapers, swapped by GNOME with the Dark Style button. Pick them on the Images page.

title: Floating dock
description: Dash to Dock at the bottom of the screen, floating and auto-hiding.
off_note: Ubuntu's dock on the left comes back.

title: Blur
description: Blur my Shell: blurred top bar, menus and overview.
off_note: The top bar and menus go back to solid colors.

title: Rounded corners
description: Rounded Window Corners Reborn: rounded corners and soft shadows on every window.
off_note: Windows get Ubuntu's square corners back.

title: Hide top bar
description: The top bar hides when a window touches it and comes back when the mouse reaches the top.
off_note: The top bar is always visible.

title: Coverflow Alt-Tab
description: Alt-Tab shows the windows as tilted cards.

title: Wobbly windows
description: Compiz windows effect: windows wobble while you drag them. Patched so the shadow follows the window.
wayland_note: On Wayland the shadow can stay behind as a square while you drag.

title: Launcher
description: Opens with Super+Space. Search Light is a Spotlight-style search drawn by GNOME; Ulauncher is a separate app with extensions.
off_note: With none, Super+Space switches the keyboard layout again, as in Ubuntu.

title: Light/dark switch
description: Switchcraft watches the Dark Style button and switches theme, icons, terminal colors and launcher with it.
after_note: Open Switchcraft → Preferences and turn Monitoring on. If it is already on, turn it off and on again: until then the Dark Style button does not switch the theme.
off_note: The Dark Style button only changes what GNOME changes by itself.

title: GTK4 live switch
description: Patched GTK4 that reloads its CSS, so open apps (Files too) switch light/dark without restarting. Held with apt-mark: GTK4 updates stop until you turn this off.
unavailable_note: Not available for your GTK version: ./install.sh can build it from source (about 45 minutes).
off_note: Ubuntu's GTK4 comes back from the archive and updates start again. The light/dark switch is turned off too.

title: Ghostty terminal
description: Ghostty as the default terminal, with a Tahoe title bar and the variant's colors. Files gets "Open in Ghostty".
off_note: GNOME Terminal is the default again, Ghostty is uninstalled.

title: Login screen
description: The login screen in the dark variant, over your dark wallpaper blurred.

title: Boot splash
description: Your logo while the computer boots, with a progress bar in the accent color. Pick the logo on the Images page.

title: NVIDIA fix
description: Uses GSK_RENDERER=gl for GTK4 apps. Fixes near-white button borders on some NVIDIA cards.
unavailable_note: No NVIDIA card in this computer.
off_note: GTK4 apps use their default renderer.
